chunks.text:
[Verse 1]
{the beat drops on the first word, no silence; iron hand-press clank as the kick}
{spoken, not sung: a calm, deadpan, close female voice, every word clear}
Mainz, fourteen ninety-two. Three a.m. One candle.
The abbot writes against the press: too fast, too much to handle.
A copy made by hand will last a thousand years.
A monk who copies, prays. Wipe the ink away. Wipe the tears.
He writes it all by hand, with love, against the black machine,
then sends it to the printer. Mainz, fourteen ninety-four. Clean.
positive_styles: metallic iron clank as kick drum

chunks.text:
[Pre-Chorus]
{whispered, the female voice, the kick drops out, a rising riser and snare roll building fast, no silence}
Be honest. Be honest.
[Chorus]
{the drop: the loudest, fullest moment so far, much bigger than the verse}
{the female voice sings the questions, euphoric, over supersaws and the male choir}
{a stacked crowd of male voices SHOUTS each answer}
Who wrote the tests?
MEA CULPA!
Who read the code?
MEA CULPA!
Who held a candle to every line?
MEA CULPA!
Be honest...
positive_styles: male choir layered with supersaw synths

chunks.text:
[Verse 2]
{spoken, not sung: the same calm, deadpan, close female voice, bouncier, every word clear}
Twenty-five percent. Then thirty. Then a half.
Then three quarters of the new code. Go ahead and laugh.
You still read it line by line, a candle and a quill,
green ticks like a rosary, and you count them still.
Looks good to me. Amen. Works on my machine. Amen.
Ship it on a Friday, then confess it all again.

chunks.text:
[Bridge]
{the beat stops dead. Only the male choir, one low held chord, cathedral reverb}
{over it, the calm female voice, very close, spoken slowly, almost a whisper}
It was never about the tests.
It was the candle you were holding,
in a room you called the world.
Outside, the world is printing.
Look up.

[Break]
{the iron clank kick returns alone, then the beat builds; stacked male voices CHANT each line, the crowd answers each with one word}
Copied by hand.
DEPRECATED.
Checked by eye.
DEPRECATED.
Read every line.
DEPRECATED.
{the female voice, close, deadpan}
And you?
